name: io.github.skill-federation/skillfed-mcp
description: Find vetted agent skills for your task, PyPI packages for your code, and the research behind both - privacy-preserving discovery over MCP.

environmentVariables.name: SKILLFED_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Hosted federation endpoint URL (defaults to the public demo Space if unset)

environmentVariables.name: SKILLFED_PACKAGES_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Package-search portal origin used by find_packages (defaults to https://skillfed.io)

environmentVariables.name: SKILLFED_RESEARCH_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Research-search portal origin used by find_research (defaults to https://skillfed.io)
